panels.title: Last export
panels.description: Seconds since the coordinator last exported metrics (every 10 s). Red means it is down or cannot reach the collector; every other panel then goes stale.

panels.title: Controllers up
panels.description: 1 when every controller started; 0 means one failed to start and its work is not happening.

panels.title: Servers
panels.description: MP servers registered with the coordinator.

panels.title: Incomplete views
panels.description: Servers the coordinator knows it is missing part of the cache for. Stays set until that server restarts or leaves: lost events are not replayed.

panels.title: Apply failures
panels.description: Batches or fences a view or controller failed to apply in the last 10 minutes: the views now disagree. Page on this.

panels.title: Stalled loops
panels.description: Background loops whose last success is more than three intervals old.

panels.title: Event loop
panels.description: Fraction of time the coordinator's event loop was blocked; above 10% delays every handler. About 0.5% is timer jitter.

panels.title: Checkpoint age
panels.description: Seconds since the last good checkpoint; a restart would come back that far behind. Empty when checkpointing is off.

panels.title: Event batches received
panels.description: Batches from MP servers by what the gate did: applied, duplicate (seq seen), stale (old incarnation).

panels.title: Events lost
panels.description: Batches that never arrived (skipped seq) and events servers reported dropping before sending.

panels.title: Apply failures by consumer
panels.description: A consumer that fails to apply a batch (consume) or fence now disagrees with the others.

panels.title: Per-server view incomplete
panels.description: 1 while the coordinator knows it is missing part of that server's cache. Stays 1 until the server restarts or leaves: lost events are not replayed.

panels.title: Per-server missing batches
panels.description: Batches from each server that never arrived, in its current run.

panels.title: Per-server dropped events
panels.description: Events each server reported dropping, in its current run.

panels.title: Seconds since last event
panels.description: Time since each server's last applied batch. High while the heartbeat is fresh means the server's event flush is stuck.

panels.title: Event delivery delay
panels.description: Server send time to coordinator apply, for each server's last batch (across two hosts' clocks).

panels.title: Seconds since heartbeat
panels.description: Time since each registered server's last heartbeat.

panels.title: Batches delivered per consumer
panels.description: Admitted batches handed to each view and controller.

panels.title: Average apply time per consumer
panels.description: Time each consumer spends applying a batch; finds the slow view (blend hashing).

panels.title: Servers registered
panels.description: MP servers registered with the coordinator.

panels.title: Membership changes
panels.description: Climbing re_registered or timed_out means servers are flapping.

panels.title: Keys tracked
panels.description: Keys with at least one placement.

panels.title: Placements by tier
panels.description: Places a key is stored: L1 on one server, or one L2 backend.

panels.title: Placement bytes by tier
panels.description: Reported logical bytes of the placements, per tier (counted once per placement).

panels.title: Fleet bytes stored
panels.description: Reported bytes the fleet holds, per tier.

panels.title: L1 keys per server
panels.description: L1 keys each server reported; a sudden drop to 0 is a fence (restart or departure).

panels.title: Blend index (when enabled)
panels.description: Size of the non-prefix (blend) index; empty unless blend lookup is enabled.

panels.title: Lookups served
panels.description: Prefix (/directory/lookup) and non-prefix (/directory/blend-lookup) lookups served.

panels.title: Lookup hit rate
panels.description: Chunks found / chunks requested.

panels.title: Chunks found per lookup
panels.description: How much each lookup found.

panels.title: Seconds since last successful pass
panels.description: Worst age per step of each loop's last success. A loop above its dashed limit (3x its interval) has stopped making progress.

panels.title: Loop passes
panels.description: Passes by result; a failed pass is logged and the loop keeps running.

panels.title: Controller up
panels.description: 1 running, 0 failed to start.

panels.title: Event loop blocked
panels.description: Fraction of time the event loop was blocked (sync work in a handler, ingest waiting on a checkpoint).

panels.title: Seconds since last good checkpoint
panels.description: Worst age per step. Alert above 600 s: a restart would come back that far behind.

panels.title: Checkpoint writes
panels.description: ok, quiesce_timeout (a batch was still applying), error.

panels.title: Checkpoint write time (p90, 15m)
panels.description: Over 15 minutes, since writes are rare. pause_ingest (waiting for in-flight batches), copy (how long ingest was paused), write.

panels.title: Checkpoint size
panels.description: Size of the last good checkpoint.

panels.title: Restored on start
panels.description: 1 for what startup did: cold (no checkpoint), restored, ignored (unreadable).

panels.title: Metadata (pin and quota) saves
panels.description: An error is a pin or quota change that will not survive a restart.

panels.title: Prefetch requests
panels.description: submitted, noop (shorter than a chunk), unknown_server, server_error.

panels.title: Prefetches in flight
panels.description: Submitted to each server and not yet seen completed.

panels.title: Prefetch hit rate
panels.description: Keys found in L2 and loaded into L1, out of keys asked to warm.

panels.title: Submit time
panels.description: Time for the MP server to accept a prefetch.

panels.title: Completion time
panels.description: Submit to the first poll that saw it completed; includes the caller's poll interval.

panels.title: Status polls and abandoned
panels.description: Polling load; abandoned = never polled to completion within 10 minutes.

panels.title: Records read
panels.description: applied, undecodable, failed.

panels.title: Partitions assigned
panels.description: Fewer than the topic has means another consumer-group member holds the rest.

panels.title: Unread records
panels.description: Records not yet read, per partition.
